title: docs(skills,AGENTS): teach `action:button` + `actionType`, retire the `events` bag
body:
Fixes #7945

The published `skills/objectui` pack and `AGENTS.md` still taught the `events` action
bag as the action system. The live dialect is `action:button` + `actionType` — the
spelling objectui#7898 / PR objectui#7931 landed and objectui#7936 / PR objectui#7949
put into quick-start. This replaces the teaching in place.

## What changed (5 sites, 4 files)

| file | site | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectui/SKILL.md` | "4. The action system (interactivity)" | `action:button` node + a `⛔ There is no events bag` note |
| `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` | "5. Use action data, not inline callback spaghetti" | `action:button` node |
| `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` | "Rule: Action Event Structure" | renamed to **"Rule: Actions Are Node Types, Not An Event Bag"**, still normative |
| `AGENTS.md` | §4 protocol sketch | the `events?` member is dropped (the sketch is declared abridged) |
| `AGENTS.md` | §5 Commandment #4 | `action:button` + an explicit never-author-`events` clause |

## Line budget

**`skills/**` net delta: +2 lines** (29 added, 27 removed) against the **+10** ceiling.
Every replacement is in place rather than delete-and-append. Whole published pack:
4604 to 4606 lines across 16 markdown files.

## Evidence the channel is dead

⚠️ **The card's own probe was vacuous and is corrected here.** The card ran

    git grep -nE '\??\.events\b' -- 'packages/*/src' 'apps/*/src'

and read its `exit 1` as "zero read points". That pathspec matches **zero tracked
files** (`git ls-files -- 'packages/*/src'` prints 0), so the probe searched nothing —
a lit control on the same pathspec (`.className`, 472 hits elsewhere) also returned
zero, which is what exposed it. Re-run over `'packages/**/src/**' 'apps/**/src/**'`
the probe returns **17 hits, none of them the SDUI node bag**: validation-rule trigger
`events` (`object-validation-engine`, `HookDefaultInspector`, `ObjectValidationsPanel`,
`ValidationPreview`), audit-log response `events` (`AuditPanel`, `ResourceHistoryPage`),
`TimelineSchema.events`, and i18n keys. **The conclusion holds; the measurement behind
it did not, and now does.**

`EventableSchema` still has exactly three references — its declaration, one union
member, one index re-export — with no extender, mirror or reader.

The decisive in-tree statement is the note on `BaseSchemaCore` in
`packages/types/src/zod/base.zod.ts`, which already names these very surfaces:

> ⚠️ `BaseSchema` declares NO `events` key ... AGENTS.md's abridged protocol sketch
> shows [an `events?` member] and its action-system commandment authors one, but
> `BaseSchemaCore` declares no such member and nothing reads `schema.events`:
> whatever a document writes under that key, no renderer runs it. `BaseSchemaCore`
> is `.passthrough()`, so such a node is KEPT, judged by nothing and run by nothing.
> ⛔ Do not send an author there.

## Gates

Derived by hand from this repo's `package.json` and `.github/workflows/` —
`dispatch-gates.mjs` derives objectstack families, not this repo's.

| gate | exit |
|:--|:--|
| `check:skill-examples` (`--self-test`, then corpus) | see below |
| `check:skills-paths` | 0 — 28/28 stated paths resolve across `skills/` |
| `check:skill-eval-tokens` | 0 |
| `check:control-bytes` | 0 |
| `check:new-line-citations` | 0 new cross-file citations |
| `check:governed-queue-guard --self-test` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-presence` | 0 — saw 4 changed files, 0 published source ⇒ none owed |
| governed classifier `--test` on all 4 paths | **3 — GOVERNED, 4 of 4** |

No changeset: markdown only, no published source of a released package and no
manifest contract moved — the gate says so rather than me.

## Scope

⛔ No new gate was built (the card rules that out: a new scanner is a new population).
`check:skill-examples` parses JSON fences but does not schema-validate them, and
`BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()`, so its green was never coverage here.

⚠️ **Two more sites exist than the card's five** — `skills/objectui/guides/architecture.md`
and the abridged sketch in `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` both still carry
an `events?` member in a `BaseSchema` teaching copy.
`guides/architecture.md` is **outside this dispatch's declared file surface**, and the
two are a matched pair that should move together, so neither sketch is edited here.
Instead the renamed rule in `rules/protocol.md` now states normatively why `events`
appears in that sketch and that nothing reads it — which covers the pair from the
authoritative file without a half-fix. See `## Acceptance notes`.

## Acceptance notes

- `objectui#9587` also edits `AGENTS.md` (hunks at 172 and 201-209); mine are at 79-107.
  **Disjoint, verified against its diff.** `origin/main` is merged into this branch.
  ⚠️ That PR is currently **not draft** although it is governed-surface; that is another
  actor's state on another PR and is left untouched, reported only.
- `noted, not filed:` the card writes the sketch type as `ActionDef[]`; the tree says
  `ActionSchema[]`. **The card is the stale one** — `ActionSchema` is declared in
  `packages/types/src/crud.ts`, while `ActionDef` is a different, app-shell-side type.
  Successor: this PR, which removes the line.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 对外发布的 `skills/objectui` 技能包和 `AGENTS.md` 里,有五处仍在教 `events`
动作包。本 PR 把这五处换成已经在跑的写法:`action:button` 节点 + `actionType`。这是替换,
不是扩写:发布包净增 **2 行**(预算上限 +10)。

**为什么改** —— 运行时根本没有人读 `events`。它不是"要废弃",是**已经死了**:`BaseSchema`
没有声明这个成员,没有任何渲染器读 `schema.events`,而节点是 `.passthrough()` 的,所以作者写
进去的东西会被**原样保留、不被校验、也不被执行** —— 没有报错,没有日志,按钮就是不动。
问题在于:**技能包才是 AI 模型实际读的那一份**。文档已经在 objectui#7936 改干净了,技能包还在
教旧的,等于我们一边发产品一边发一份会让客户写出死代码的说明书。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 风险低:纯文档,没有代码改动,没有发布契约变化,因此不欠 changeset
(门禁自己判的,不是我说的)。唯一实质判断是 `rules/protocol.md` 那条规则改了标题
(`Rule: Action Event Structure` → `Rule: Actions Are Node Types, Not An Event Bag`);
已确认全仓没有任何地方引用旧标题锚点。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit,无迁移、无残留。

**席位意见** ——

**你要做的** —— 一个动作:看一眼 diff,同意就**人工合并**。本 PR 四个文件全部落在受管面上
(门禁判定 `GOVERNED — 4 of 4`),所以它**停在 draft**,不入队、不自动合并,也不会有 agent
给它批准 —— 按规矩这条只能由你来落。
